purpose: Verify that gang membership is stock-and-flow rather than a target-size progression and that the old 8->12 result is not preserved.

research_use.principle: External gang research supports high heterogeneity, short tenure for many less-embedded members, and longer persistence among embedded/core members. Exact modern youth-gang rates are not copied into Caerness; they motivate tiered turnover only.
sources: National Gang Center FAQ / survey analysis on gang membership duration and gang size variation
NIJ Continuity and Change in Gang Membership and Gang Embeddedness
OJP/NIJ literature distinguishing core, regular/active and peripheral/fringe participation

removed_anchors: automatic peripheral associates equal to ~45% of full membership
lazy profile clock that discarded turnover before first membership review
acceptance: PASS: sampled outcomes include contraction, near-flat full membership, a large fluid periphery, and material expansion; gross turnover is much larger than net change; no fixed 12-member endpoint or small-gang recruitment ceiling remains.
note: This file reflects the discarded eight-member Cale opening and is retained only as pre-recalibration diagnostic history.
